title: Choosing a material for a use
misconception: 1D-M2: thinks one material (metal) is best for every job
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: No single material is best for every job.
A football needs to bounce and be light. Rubber and leather work well.
A metal ball would be strong, but far too heavy to kick.
A goal net must be light and bend. Nylon rope works.
A market basket made of cane is light, and strong enough to carry goods.
A bucket for water needs a waterproof material, like plastic.
Each job needs its own properties, so match the material to the job.
Now it is your turn. Say which material suits the job, and why.
